message.content:
Build 3 features for Rankora at `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Rankora`: ZIP Upload, Candidate Tags, Candidate Assignment.

Read CLAUDE.md first. Then read: `src/components/BulkUploadZone.tsx`, `src/components/JobDetailView.tsx`, `src/components/CandidateRow.tsx`, `src/components/CandidateDetailSheet.tsx`, `src/components/KanbanBoard.tsx`, `src/hooks/useTeam.tsx`, `package.json`.

## Feature 1: ZIP Upload

Add ZIP file support to BulkUploadZone. Install `jszip` if needed (`npm install jszip`).

When a .zip file is dropped:
1. Dynamically import JSZip: `const JSZip = (await import('jszip')).default;`
2. Extract all files, filter to only resume types (pdf/docx/doc/rtf/txt)
3. Add extracted files to the upload queue
4. Show toast: "Extracted X resumes from ZIP"
5. Update drop zone text to mention ZIP support

## Feature 2: Candidate Tags

### Migration `supabase/migrations/20260409200000_candidate_tags_and_assignment.sql`:
```sql
CREATE TABLE public.candidate_tags (
  id uuid PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  resume_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.resumes(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  job_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES public.jobs(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  tag text NOT NULL,
  color text NOT NULL DEFAULT '#6366f1',
  created_by uuid REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL,
  created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
  UNIQUE(resume_id, tag)
);
CREATE INDEX idx_candidate_tags_resume ON public.candidate_tags(resume_id);
CREATE INDEX idx_candidate_tags_job ON public.candidate_tags(job_id, tag);
ALTER TABLE public.candidate_tags ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Team view tags" ON public.candidate_tags FOR SELECT TO authenticated
  USING (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.jobs j LEFT JOIN public.team_members tm ON tm.team_id = j.team_id AND tm.user_id = auth.uid() WHERE j.id = candidate_tags.job_id AND (j.user_id = auth.uid() OR tm.user_id IS NOT NULL)));
CREATE POLICY "Team manage tags" ON public.candidate_tags FOR ALL TO authenticated
  USING (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.jobs j LEFT JOIN public.team_members tm ON tm.team_id = j.team_id AND tm.user_id = auth.uid() WHERE j.id = candidate_tags.job_id AND (j.user_id = auth.uid() OR tm.user_id IS NOT NULL)));

ALTER TABLE public.resumes ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS assigned_to uuid REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL;
```

### Hook `src/hooks/useCandidateTags.tsx`:
- Fetch all tags for a job
- addTag(resumeId, tag, color) / removeTag(tagId) mutations
- Return: tags grouped by resumeId, allTagNames for autocomplete
- Realtime subscription

### Component `src/components/candidate/CandidateTagInput.tsx`:
- Shows tags as colored chips with X to remove
- Input with autocomplete from existing tags
- Preset suggestions: Shortlisted, On Hold, Top Choice, Follow Up, Culture Fit
- 6 color presets

### Integrate:
- CandidateDetailSheet: add tag input section
- CandidateRow: show tag chips after name
- KanbanBoard: show first 2 tags on cards
- JobDetailView: add tag filter dropdown

## Feature 3: Candidate Assignment

DB column already in migration above: `resumes.assigned_to`.

### Component `src/components/candidate/AssigneeSelector.tsx`:
- Dropdown of team members with initials avatars
- Currently assigned highlighted
- Unassign option
- On select: update resumes.assigned_to

### Integrate:
- CandidateDetailSheet: AssigneeSelector in header
- CandidateRow: small assignee badge
- KanbanBoard: assignee initials on cards

## Constraints
- NEVER edit `src/integrations/supabase/types.ts`
- `(supabase as any)` for new tables
- `@/` imports, shadcn-ui only, Sonner toasts
- Run `npm run build` — zero errors
